summary_en: 150,300 shares (1.83% of S/O ex-treasury) to be acquired via ToSTNeT-3 on 2026-08-03 at ¥6,650/share (day's close); total ¥999.5M. Single-session order only.
title_en: Notice Regarding Acquisition of Treasury Shares via Off-Auction Proprietary Transaction (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: The Kita-Nippon Bank announced on 2026-07-31 that its board of directors resolved to acquire treasury shares via off-auction trading (ToSTNeT-3) on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The specific block transaction terms are: 150,300 common shares to be acquired at ¥6,650 per share (the closing price as of 2026-07-31) via a single ToSTNeT-3 order at 08:45 on 2026-08-03, for a total ¥999,495,000. The 150,300 shares represent 1.83% of the 8,198,032 shares outstanding excluding treasury stock. The order is valid only during the specified trading session; market conditions may result in partial or no execution. Results will be disclosed after trading ends on 2026-08-03. This block acquisition is authorized under a broader board resolution permitting acquisition of up to 190,000 shares (2.31% of S/O ex-treasury) for up to ¥1,000 million during the period 2026-08-03 to 2026-08-31.
